This is audits/seam/turn_structure.json guard G3 observed at a second site (the seam's own witness is Pael's Eye skipping the turn-end pass generally); one verdict per mechanism, binding rule 3. ScreamingFlagon.cs:21 implements the plain, LAST one, so C# guarantees the Flagon's 20 damage lands after Orichalcum's and Fake Orichalcum's VeryEarly Block snapshot and after Pael's Eye's Early hand exhaust. hooks.on_player_turn_end is a single walk in relic-registration order. Pael's Eye's hand EXHAUST would matter (it empties the hand, which is the Flagon's gate) but it is unreachable in combination because the same relic's ShouldTakeExtraTurn short-circuits the pass first -- that is G2, and fixing G2 makes this half live immediately: once the pass runs, C# exhausts the hand in the Early pass and then the Flagon sees an empty hand, while the sim's order decides it. So the fix-ordering note matters here: G2 must be fixed together with the pass separation, not before it. The mechanism is LIVE and verdicted `gap` at the seam (Orichalcum x Cloak Clasp, 5 block vs 11); binding rule 3. Rule 7: Hook.cs, turn_structure.json and relics/orichalcum.py are not hashed here.

Rule 7: cmds.py, audits/relic/bag_of_marbles.json and audits/seam/power_cmd.json are not hashed here.
